=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:624-633 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The cached-text `[skip ai]` fallback skips review for sync-named PRs on `workflow_dispatch` even when provenance was rejected for a reason other than `sync_identity_unavailable`.
  WHY: A non-genuine PR can set `[skip ai]` in its fetched title or body and bypass review, contrary to the requirement to review other matching PRs normally; severity was reported as BLOCKER by four reviewers and MAJOR by two, so the highest severity is used.
- docs/implement-plan/issue-5610-limit-twin-sync-review-skip.md:41 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The lesson says the `[skip ai]` fallback only works on `pull_request` runs, contradicting the added cached-text fallback for twin-sync heads on `workflow_dispatch`.
  WHY: `scripts/ingest_implement_plan_lessons.py` ingests valid lesson lines into AI memory, where this stale statement can mislead future runs.
- tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py:644-663 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The dispatch fallback test covers only `sync_identity_unavailable`, not a non-genuine twin-sync PR with `[skip ai]` in cached text.
  WHY: CI cannot detect the bypass where such a PR skips review instead of being reviewed normally.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Limit the exemption to this repository and verify same-repository head provenance and the sync workflow's bot identity; review every other matching PR normally." (issue #5610)

  EVIDENCE: The `elif` checks only the sync-head prefix and cached `[skip ai]` text, not whether the denial reason was `sync_identity_unavailable`; `gate_twin_sync_exempt` keeps `deny_reason` local, so the fallback cannot distinguish transient identity lookup failure from rejected provenance.
- requirement: The implement-plan log's `## Lessons` section must reflect implemented behavior because `scripts/ingest_implement_plan_lessons.py` ingests valid lesson lines into AI memory on merge.

- requirement: A test must cover a non-genuine `claude/claude-twin-sync-*` PR with `[skip ai]` in cached text on `workflow_dispatch` and assert that it is reviewed normally.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py, alongside `test_gate_twin_sync_skip_marker_is_read_from_the_fetched_pr_on_dispatch`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Existing dispatch coverage tests genuine `sync_identity_unavailable` cases, while the non-genuine provenance tests do not combine `workflow_dispatch` with cached `[skip ai]` text.
- requirement: The plan must document every behavior the implementation ships, including the cached-text fallback on `workflow_dispatch` and the decision to add it.
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/issue-5610-limit-twin-sync-review-skip-plan.md, "Implementation Steps" and "Auto-decisions" sections
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The plan does not reference `pr_title_cached`, `pr_body_cached`, or the new `elif`; its step 2 omits the fallback and the Auto-decisions section has no entry for that decision.
- requirement: The "Other automation stays out" bullet under "Claude twin sync" must describe the cached-text fallback restriction accurately once the security regression is fixed.
  expected_change_site: agents.md, "Other automation stays out" bullet under "Claude twin sync" (lines 1256-1279)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: agents.md lines 1264-1270 describe the cached-text fallback without restricting it to the `sync_identity_unavailable` case.
